## Why This Is Asked
Tests ability to design multi-tenant TLS handling, dynamic routing, and safe deployments across hybrid clusters, tying together secrets, configs, and feature flags.

## Key Concepts
- Docker secrets/configs per tenant
- Nginx TLS SNI-based cert selection
- Redis-backed per-tenant rate limiting
- Consul KV feature flags for canary routing
- Swarm update_config with rollback on failure

## Code Example
```yaml
version: '3.8'
services:
  edge:
    image: nginx:1.25
    ports:
      - '443:443'
    secrets:
      - tenantA.crt
      - tenantA.key
      - tenantB.crt
      - tenantB.key
    configs:
      - source: nginx_tenant_map
        target: /etc/nginx/conf.d/tenant_map.conf
    deploy:
      replicas: 3
      update_config:
        parallelism: 1
        delay: 5s
        order: start-first
        failure_action: rollback
configs:
  nginx_tenant_map:
    file: ./nginx/tenant_map.conf
```

- How would you test canary rollout without affecting production traffic?
- How would you audit tenant isolation and key rotation?
- What are the failure modes if Redis is unreachable during rollout?

## Why This Is Asked

Tests practical skills in observability, canary deployments, and Docker DCA cluster management.

## Key Concepts

- OpenTelemetry instrumentation and Jaeger trace visualization
- OTLP (OpenTelemetry Protocol) exporter configuration
- Nginx traffic splitting and header-based canary routing
- Prometheus metrics collection and TLS-secured API exposure
- Docker DCA cluster orchestration with docker-compose

## Code Example

```yaml
version: '3.8'
services:
  api-v1:
    image: myrepo/api:v1
    environment:
      - OTEL_SERVICE_NAME=api-v1
      - OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=otel-collector:4317
  
  api-v2:
    image: myrepo/api:v2
    environment:
      - OTEL_SERVICE_NAME=api-v2
      - OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=otel-collector:4317
  
  nginx:
    image: nginx:latest
    ports:
      - '443:443'
    volumes:
      - ./nginx.conf:/etc/nginx/nginx.conf:ro
      - ./certs:/etc/nginx/certs:ro
  
  otel-collector:
    image: otel/opentelemetry-collector:latest
    volumes:
      - ./otel-config.yaml:/etc/otel/config.yaml:ro
  
  jaeger:
    image: jaegertracing/all-in-one:1.42
    ports:
      - '16686:16686'
  
  prometheus:
    image: prom/prometheus:latest
    ports:
      - '9090:9090'
    volumes:
      - ./prometheus.yml:/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml:ro
```

# Deploy the cluster
docker-compose up -d

# Verify services

# Test canary routing

```

services:

   image: myapi:2.0

     replicas: 3

       parallelism: 1
       order: start-first
     labels:
       - "version=production"
   networks:

     test: ["CMD", "curl", "-f", "http://localhost:8080/health"]
     interval: 30s
     timeout: 10s
     retries: 3

   image: myapi:2.0-canary

     replicas: 1

       parallelism: 1
       order: start-first
     labels:
       - "version=canary"
   networks:
     - front
 redis:
   image: redis:alpine
   deploy:
     replicas: 1
   networks:
     - front
networks:
 front:
   driver: overlay

```

services:

        target: tls.crt
    deploy:
      update_config:
        parallelism: 1
        delay: 10s
        failure_action: rollback
        order: start-first

        test: ["CMD", "curl", "-f", "http://localhost:80/health"]

        timeout: 10s

    image: myorg/cert-rotator:latest
    secrets:
      - source: tls_cert
        target: tls.crt
      - source: vault_token
        target: vault.token
    deploy:
      replicas: 1
secrets:
  tls_cert:
    external: true
  vault_token:
    external: true
```

local key = KEYS[1]
local ttl = ARGV[1]
local current = redis.call('GET', key)
if current then

else

  end
  return nil
end
```

## Why This Is Asked

## Key Concepts

- Envoy sidecar injection and Traefik as an edge proxy
- Dynamic policy storage in Consul KV with hot-reload via consul-template
- Multi-data center architecture considerations and zero-downtime updates

## Code Example

```yaml
version: '3.9'
services:
  traefik:
    image: traefik:v3.0
    command:
      - --providers.consulcatalog
      - --providers.consulcatalog.endpoint.address=consul:8500
    ports:
      - "443:443"
    volumes:
      - ./traefik-dynamic.yml:/dynamic.yml:ro
    environment:
      - CONSUL_HTTP_ADDR=consul:8500

  consul:
    image: consul:1.17
    command: agent -server -ui -bootstrap-expect=1 -client=0.0.0.0
    ports:
      - "8500:8500"

  consul-template:
    image: hashicorp/consul-template:latest
    command: -consul-addr=consul:8500 -template "/tmp/intentions.hcl:/etc/consul-intentions/intentions.hcl:consul reload"
    volumes:
      - ./intentions.ctmpl:/tmp/intentions.hcl

  backend-tenant-a:
    image: your-backend:latest
    labels:
      - "consul.hashicorp.com/service=api-tenant-a"
      - "consul.hashicorp.com/enable-ingress-gateway=true"

  backend-tenant-b:
    image: your-backend:latest
    labels:
      - "consul.hashicorp.com/service=api-tenant-b"
```

## Bootstrap Commands

```bash
# Initialize Consul agent
consul agent -config-dir=/etc/consul.d &

# Register services with Consul
consul services register -name=api-tenant-a -id=api-tenant-a
consul services register -name=api-tenant-b -id=api-tenant-b

# Create intentions for tenant isolation
consul intention create -deny "tenant-failing" "api-tenant-a"
consul intention create -allow "tenant-permitted" "api-tenant-a"

# Enable Envoy sidecar injection
consul connect envoy -sidecar-for api-tenant-a -register &

# Reload Traefik on policy changes
consul-template -template=intentions.ctmpl -exec="traefik --reload"
```
